The Gathering for Open Science Hardware (GOSH) Science Events Funding program is for groups that want to host an event, workshop, conference, or get-together aimed at supporting open science hardware.

In 2023, we funded events that had a clear focus on promoting or advancing open science hardware within a specific discipline including (but not limited to) the following: Space science, Imaging, Neuroscience, Microscopy, Conservation technology, Oceanography, Chemistry, Science and Technology Studies.

Image Credit: [Gathering for Open Science Hardware](https://www.flickr.com/photos/goshcommunity/43754536270/in/album-72157674579730208/)
